title: PrismCrawl Google Play API input
description: Search Google Play apps, games, books, and movies, get product details, and collect app reviews through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Searches use Search query; product details and reviews use Product ID.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Text to search for (search modes). Optional for games when a games category is set.

gamesCategory.title: Games category
gamesCategory.description: For games: a Google Play Games category to browse, such as GAME_ACTION or GAME_PUZZLE. Combine with a query to return only games in that category.

id.title: Product ID
id.description: For product details and reviews: the ID from Google Play search results or the id parameter of the store URL, such as com.google.android.apps.maps. App names are not IDs.

productCategory.title: Product type
productCategory.description: For product details: the store section of the product. Leave empty for apps.

sort_by.title: Review order
sort_by.description: For reviews: the order to return them in.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (searches and reviews only). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

limit.title: Items per page
limit.description: Maximum results or reviews per page (1–100). Google Play may return fewer.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country or storefront code, such as us or gb.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code supported by the provider, such as en.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
